title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Bronze Tobacco 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Bronze Tobacco offers a rich and satisfying blend of smooth Tobacco with subtly sweet and nutty undertones. The deep, earthy notes of Tobacco are balanced by a gentle caramelised finish, delivering a bold yet refined vaping experience. Formulated for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides a smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-rounded flavour clarity and discreet vapour production, making it an ideal choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle comes with a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
